workflow_goal: Create a new named folder inside a specific Google Drive directory and upload a local file into it.

readable_roots.reason: The local file to upload to Google Drive must be read from disk.

constants.folder_name_pattern: v0 - <today's date, e.g. '30 May'>; if that folder already exists under the parent, append ' - 2' (and increment further on subsequent collisions).

steps.title: Create Drive folder and upload file via Drive API
steps.goal: Use the authenticated Google Drive (via existing signed-in Chrome session or Drive API) directly instead of driving Spotlight/file picker: resolve the fixed target parent directory (constant URL https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1M1E4LNjEXLvaH7j5JY1Un3XRx6M6mtvV), compute folder_name as 'v0 - <today's date>' and, if a folder with that name already exists under the parent, append ' - 2' (incrementing on further collisions), create that new folder under the parent, then upload the fixed local file (/Users/prakharjain/code/ai_mime/dist/AI Mime.dmg) into the newly created folder. Return the new folder ID and uploaded file ID. All values are constants — no user inputs.
steps.success_criteria: API returns a folder with the given name under the parent, and the uploaded file appears inside it with a non-zero size matching the local file.

steps.title: Verify file resides in the new folder
steps.goal: Reload the new folder URL in the signed-in Chrome session and confirm a row for the uploaded file (AI Mime.dmg) is present inside new_folder_id with a non-zero file size (~246.6 MB) shown in the listing. Report success/failure.
steps.success_criteria: Drive API confirms the file is listed inside the newly created folder and reports a complete, fully-sized upload.
